summary: This ILMINES Wiki page is the mine index record for Sahara No. 21 Mine (Mine Index 0911), an underground coal mine operated by Sahara Coal Company, Inc. in Saline County, Illinois, from 1970 to 1993. It records the mine's location, acreage, the Springfield seam geology and mining methods, reported roof conditions, and total production of 12,487,858 tons. Sources listed include Coal Reports, the Directory of Illinois Coal Mines, mine notes, and a company map dated 10-5-50.
one_line: Mine index record for Sahara No. 21 Mine, an underground Springfield-seam coal mine in Saline County, Illinois, operated 1970-1993.
key_facts: Mine Index Number 0911 identifies the Sahara No. 21 Mine, operated by Sahara Coal Company, Inc.
The Sahara No. 21 Mine was an underground mine with a start date of 1970 and an end date of 1993.
The mine's total acres shown on the map are 3,107.
The main slope of the Sahara No. 21 Mine is located in Saline County, Township 9S Range 5E, Section 17, NE SE SE.
The air shaft of the Sahara No. 21 Mine is located in Saline County, Township 9S Range 5E, Section 17, SE SE SE.
The mined seam is the Springfield seam, at a depth of 210-280 feet.
The Springfield seam thickness ranges from 4.3 to 5.0 feet, with a minimum of 6.0 feet listed in the thickness column.
Longwall mining was done in the northwest part of the Sahara No. 21 Mine, and pillars were pulled in several areas in the northern and southwestern parts.
The roof was good throughout the Sahara No. 21 Mine, and falls occurred only along faulted or sheared roof areas.
The Sahara No. 21 Mine had many discontinuous faults and fractures.
Total production from the Sahara No. 21 Mine for 1970-1993 was 12,487,858 tons.
The source map is a company map dated 10-5-50, digitized at a scale of 1:12000 and marked as Final with a map date of 10-20-1994.
The mine is listed in Saline County and Williamson County, with quadrangles Carrier Mills, Harco, and Pittsburg.
